# Re-fetch full note content and extract Tarantino-directed movie titles
sn_pw = [a for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]['password']
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='gl.moore@gmail.com', password=sn_pw)['access_token']
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=sn_token, note_id=1556)
content = note['content']
print('content_length', len(content))

lines = content.splitlines()
current_title = None
order = []
seen = set()

for line in lines:
    s = line.strip()
    if not s:
        continue
    if s.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if not line.startswith(' ') and not s.startswith('-'):
        # likely a title line
        current_title = s
        continue
    # director line?
    if 'director:' in s and 'Quentin Tarantino' in s:
        if current_title and current_title not in seen:
            seen.add(current_title)
            order.append(current_title)

print('tarantino_titles', order)
